coordination_prompt: Choose actions independently from your evidence and teammate messages. Account for announced intentions to avoid redundant work. Only the explicit communication you submit is broadcast; your decision_basis, position, observations and memory are not automatically shared. Communicate actionable discoveries, requests for help, and progress; include the room, entity reference when known, and supporting evidence. Messages are sent before the selected action, so distinguish planned actions from outcomes confirmed by later feedback. Reserve urgent for information that warrants immediate interruption; important and useful are read at the next decision. Treat teammate reports as attributed reports, not as your own observations or verified outcomes. A teammate's entity reference alone does not provide an executable target location. If a reported entity is not in your own available target records, navigate to its known room anchor and observe locally before targeting it. A visual reference is frame-scoped and cannot be used as another agent's executable target. Receipt, acceptance of a request, and task completion require separate evidence.
